scope: Sensitivity within the tested synthetic parameter grid on one deliberately selected corridor; not operational or real-world robustness

controlledInputs.description: Fictional eastbound Ang Mo Kio–Serangoon demonstration using unchanged prepared Census 2020 resident population geography. Deliberately selected for a non-monotonic exposure story; not operationally calibrated.

synthetic_assumptions.threat_trajectory: fictional straight eastbound path; not an observed or predicted real threat
synthetic_assumptions.launch_origin: fictional supplied point; not an operational site
synthetic_assumptions.footprint_radius: 100 m supplied consequence circle; not calculated debris physics
synthetic_assumptions.success_profile: supplied linear decay; not a validated success estimate
synthetic_assumptions.scenario_time: fixed presentation-only clock; no model significance
synthetic_assumptions.visualization_height: 1000 m presentation only; backend model is 2D

comparisonSemantics: lowestExposure minus earliestViable, including zero deltas for a shared representative; complete finite exposure required; zero reference has null relative change
